product_from_film: Claude can create a small CSV analysis artifact that accepts a file, displays rows and generates charts or tables from requests.
explains_well: The same uploaded data stays in one app while three requests produce a line chart, agent table and city bar chart.
unclear: The share dialog is shown, but the film does not hold a copied-link confirmation or recipient view.
scenario: Create a CSV visualizer, upload sales data, ask several analysis questions and open sharing.
product_clear_basis: The prompt describes creating a CSV Data Visualizer; the named artifact and upload area follow at 7–9s.

categories.finding: Create app → upload → three analysis requests → share.
Simple shapes and hands quickly lead into the real prompt surface.
The CSV app request explains the task by 6s, and upload makes its input concrete.
Reframing enlarges the request; table and chart states replace each other in one panel. Exact chart animation is unverified.
A consistent app panel carries the workflow, then a share modal and brand shape close it.
Terracotta surround contrasts with white UI and blue controls; the last chart adds several colors.
Requests and chart titles are readable; table cells and source values are smaller.
Voice delivery is unverified.
Music character and structure are unverified.
Effects and their sources are unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening; waveform peaks do not identify effects.

categories.finding: Sound sync is unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening or paired audiovisual timing.

categories.finding: Prompt UI, file upload, preview table, charts and share modal are visible; data provenance and execution unverified.
Source duration 43.066 s; Watch metadata 1920 × 1080. Frame rate, audio clipping and export quality not checked here.
categories.reason: Parent source metadata supports duration and dimensions; visual review is sampled.

categories.finding: The request-button-processing-result pattern is readable without sound.
The prompt and output occupy the same stable area, reducing the need to search for changes.
Three related analyses fit in about 26s because each repeats the same interaction.
File upload pays off in multiple labeled views of the data; sharing stops before confirmation.
Repeated simple requests may suggest flexibility and ease; no viewer test was performed.
One CSV and request bar connect the line chart, agent table and city chart.
Chart calculations, data interpretation, runtime behavior and share access were not verified. The trend chart specifically labels average sales price, not every possible sales metric.
The file-upload artifact behaves as a small app with its own analysis control, rather than only a chat reply.
Complete the sharing payoff.
categories.experiment: Hold the copied-link confirmation or show the shared artifact opening.

categories.experiment: For Tin, keep one campaign dataset and show a trend, a channel comparison and a geographic view with clear metric labels.

lessons.open: Calculations, data provenance, live execution, sharing and sound remain unverified.
